art_instructions: Draw a medium shot from eye level showing Dinosaur arriving to meet Panda inside the family house. Dinosaur should be cheerful and upright, walking forward with a big friendly smile, his short tail slightly lifted, and his three stubby fingers waving gently in greeting. Panda is standing in front of him, looking up with a welcoming expression, ears forward and small panda paws held gently together. Both characters should be drawn in chibi style with rounded, soft outlines, smooth 2-4px line weight, and pastel colors. Dinosaur's scales are smooth pea-green with a pale mint belly. Panda has classic black patches around his eyes and ears, with soft white face and belly. Set them within the cozy woodland cottage interior: natural wood walls and floor, low wooden furniture, soft green cushions, cream curtains. Include simple shapes like a child-sized table and chairs arranged in friendly circles. Use warm natural lighting and maintain a centered, balanced composition with generous negative space.
